description: Japanese documents through validate_document with no caller constraints: the ja profile's defaults (13 full-width characters per line, 4 characters per second; Netflix Japanese Timed Text Style Guide), width-weighted counting (half-width = 0.5), and kinsoku at existing line breaks. `expected` lists (code, cue_id) of every observation; `suggested_text` is checked where given.

cases.name: 13 full-width characters fit; 14 do not (the generic 42-character default would accept both)

cues.text: 今日はとても良い天気ですね
今日はとても良い天気ですね。

cases.name: half-width characters count 0.5: 7 Latin letters + 7 full-width = 10.5 units fit in 13
reading speed 4 characters per second: 8 in 2 s passes, 9 in 2 s does not
a line may not start with 。 -- reported with a kinsoku-compliant re-break

。散歩に行きましょう。
